items.title: Centre to sell onions at Rs 35/kg in Delhi from Thursday amid price surge
items.summary: Onion prices: The cooperative agency will retail onions through 100 Kendriya Bhandar stores and is in talks with Mother Dairy for sale through its 300 outlets, besides deploying mobile vans -- 15 initially, rising to 40 from the day after tomorrow.

items.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 26 Aug: SBFC Finance, Capri Global, Hindustan Copper, SAIL, OLA, Vedanta among top gainers
items.summary: The Indian stock market closed lower on August 26, with banking and metal gains offset by losses in technology and consumer goods sectors. Nifty 50 fell 0.52% to 24,207, while Sensex decreased 0.05% to 77,614 amid mixed broader market performance.

items.title: EAC-PM paper suggests consolidation of banks of equal size without compromising market competition
items.summary: The Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister proposed consolidating Indian banks into larger, equally sized entities. This consolidation aims to support the economy's growing credit needs and achieve Viksit Bharat by 2047. Recent mergers reduced public sector banks, bringing scale and potential operational synergies to the industry. Data shows improved efficiency in public sector banks, surpassing private banks in recent years.

items.title: HP seals multi-year Wi-Fi patent deal with US-blacklisted Huawei | Full details here
items.summary: Huawei and HP Inc. have signed a multiyear cross-licensing agreement for Wi-Fi-related patents, including Wi-Fi 7. The deal allows both companies access to each other's patents, amidst ongoing US restrictions on Huawei.

items.title: India has fixed its PSU banks. Now comes the more ambitious part
items.summary: The EAC-PM has proposed consolidating India’s public sector banks into a few large, comparable institutions to meet rising credit demand and finance the country’s growth towards Viksit Bharat 2047. The recommendation comes after a major PSB turnaround, with stronger profits, lower NPAs and faster credit growth. Larger banks could better fund infrastructure, manufacturing, technology and overseas expansion.

items.title: Sensex falls 183 points, Nifty closes below 24,250 as market erases all morning gains. What lies ahead?
items.summary: The Indian stock markets experienced a shift, dropping from earlier gains with both Sensex and Nifty closing lower. Key decliners included Infosys, Bharti Airtel, and L&T. Meanwhile, Kotak Mahindra Bank's shares surged over three percent, contrasting with the mixed performance of broader markets, where small caps thrived while mid caps faced challenges. Interestingly, despite the main indices' downturn, the market breadth showed a favor for advancing stocks.

items.title: India to divert 350,000 tonnes of sugar exports to local market amid shortage
items.summary: Indian refiners will divert 350,000 tons of sugar offshore to the domestic market. This move aims to ease a significant supply crunch and tame surging prices. Authorities have cleared the release of these stockpiles to domestic buyers within a week. This intervention will provide near-term relief for consumers during the festival season. Sugar prices have already begun to cool down following government intervention.

items.title: Why we should all get used to high household energy bills
items.summary: The government is under pressure to support billpayers when domestic energy prices predicted to rise further.

items.title: Avaada Electro cuts IPO size to ₹7,600 crore amid valuation, concentration concerns
items.summary: The solar manufacturer lowered its target from a potential ₹10,000 crore after prospective investors flagged heavy revenue reliance on its group entity and rising competition in the sector.

items.title: Stock market today: Sensex falls 183 points, Nifty 50 ends at 24,208; mid, small-caps outperform
items.summary: Stock market today: The Sensex ended 183 points, or 0.24%, lower at 77,472.94, while the Nifty 50 declined 127 points, or 0.52%, to settle at 24,207.75.

items.title: Home loan portfolio set to cross Rs 10 lakh cr milestone this quarter: SBI Chairman
items.summary: The mortgage portfolio of State Bank of India is set to hit a monumental Rs 10 lakh crore this quarter, highlighting its robust role in the housing finance sector with 28 percent market share in home loans. SBI is dedicated to ensuring home loans are readily available to customers nationwide through extensive processing facilities.

items.title: Disney layoffs: Hollywood giant offers voluntary early retirement packages to longtime executives as job cuts continue
items.summary: The initiative allows eligible executives to leave the company voluntarily while receiving enhanced benefits in recognition of their years of service.

items.title: Nestle CEO outlines new road map for "very attractive" India market
items.summary: Nestle SA is gearing up for major investments in India, positioning it as a key player in its global operations. With a vision to rank among its top five markets, Nestle recognises the potential of the burgeoning middle class and rising consumption, the company's CEO said. The new strategy will emphasize growth in volume and product quality while enhancing India's significance as a manufacturing and export hub.

items.title: Hindustan Copper shares up 5.6%, OFS opened for retail investors today

items.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $79K ahead of US PCE, GDP Data; whales book record $1.2 billion profit in 3 days
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $79,000 on Wednesday as traders await key US PCE inflation and GDP data. While the broader trend remains bullish, rising profit-taking and resistance around $82,800–$83,000 could limit near-term gains. Short-term holder whales have booked a record $1.2 billion in profits over three days, adding to market caution.

items.title: U.S. crude hovers around $80 as oil prices sink on Hormuz deal hopes
items.summary: Oil fell Wednesday, as investors continue to assess the U.S. pivot toward economic sanctions rather than military strikes to add pressure on Iran.

items.title: Adani’s Cemindia is said to near up to $524 million share sale
items.summary: Adani Group-backed Cemindia Projects, formerly known as ITD Cementation India, is preparing to launch a qualified institutional placement (QIP) to raise up to Rs 5,000 crore. The company has appointed ICICI Securities and SBI Capital Markets as advisers and has been meeting institutional investors ahead of the potential share sale.

items.title: Penny stock under ₹5 hits upper circuit after the board approves issuing warrants on a preferential basis
items.summary: Despite weak market sentiment, NHC Foods jumped 5% to its upper circuit of ₹2.05 in intraday deals on the BSE on Wednesday, 26 August. The stock has been rising for the last 15 consecutive sessions. Over this period, it has nearly doubled.

items.title: Capri Global Capital shares pop 9% on strong volumes, hit highest level in over a month
items.summary: Capri Global Capital's shares surged 9% on August 26 to ₹260.85, driven by increased trading volumes, despite no clear trigger. With a cumulative rise of 16.5% over three days and over 40% year-to-date gains, the company reported a significant profit increase for the June quarter.

items.title: Nestle backs stricter food labelling norms, says transparency key for consumers
items.summary: Nestle’s global CEO Philipp Navratil has backed FSSAI’s tighter food-labelling scrutiny and supported front-of-pack disclosures, saying consumers should know what they eat. He said such rules should be scientifically designed, balanced and based on portion sizes and global best practices.

items.title: Haidilao shares jump as delivery growth and new restaurant brands boost outlook
items.summary: Haidilao shares rose after results showed strong growth in delivery and newer restaurant formats, even as revenue from its core hotpot restaurants declined.

items.title: Global Market: Mexico’s ‘Super Peso’ rally puts exporters under pressure
items.summary: Mexico’s peso has emerged as one of the strongest-performing emerging-market currencies in 2026, strengthening past 17 per dollar despite weak growth and US trade tensions. The “super peso” is helping curb import costs and inflation but is hurting exporters, especially firms reliant on US revenues.

items.title: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
items.summary: A household using a typical amount of gas and electricity will pay £60 a year more, regulator Ofgem says.

items.title: Indian engineering giant L&T’s order wins signal Middle East revival
items.summary: Larsen & Toubro reported an impressive acquisition of thirteen new orders since the beginning of July, including seven contracts from the Middle East. This trend is a clear sign of revitalized economic activity in the area. The company heavily relies on its Middle Eastern revenue for overall earnings. With businesses rekindling infrastructure projects, it's anticipated that project awards will continue to increase, supporting further development.

items.title: Skyways Air, Symbiotec Pharmalab IPOs Day 3: Cross 4x subscription
items.summary: Skyways Air Services IPO was subscribed 4.48 times and Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO was subscribed 4.45 times at the time of writing (2.42 pm)

items.title: Convening India's brightest minds: The Bharat Life Sciences Award’s Innovation Summit to spotlight life sciences
items.summary: India sets its sights on becoming a frontrunner in innovation within the life sciences arena. The Bharat Life Sciences Award 2026 aims to honor exceptional scientific achievements while promoting teamwork. With leaders gathering to enhance manufacturing and drug discovery capabilities, discussions will delve into topics like AI-driven discovery and cutting-edge vaccine technologies, ultimately aiming to define the future of India's life sciences landscape.

items.title: Global Market: ECB may raise rates in September as Iran war fuels inflation concerns: Reports
items.summary: European Central Bank policymakers are increasingly leaning towards a September rate hike as the Iran conflict drives up energy prices and inflation. While inflation is nearing 3% and economic activity remains resilient, officials appear reluctant to signal further tightening beyond September, keeping future decisions dependent on incoming data.

items.title: Mold-Tek Packaging board approves 1:1 bonus issue, Rs 3 final dividend
items.summary: Mold-Tek Packaging’s board has approved a 1:1 bonus issue and recommended a final dividend of Rs 3 per share for FY26. Under the proposal, shareholders will receive one bonus share of Rs 5 face value for every share held. The company will announce the record date later, while the dividend will be declared at its annual general meeting.

items.title: IICT, Netflix announce scholarships for 100 students across six creative programmes
items.summary: The Indian Institute of Creative Technologies and Netflix are offering scholarships to one hundred students. These scholarships provide up to eighty percent financial support for six professional creative programs. This initiative aims to strengthen India's creative talent pipeline and its AVGC sector. The collaboration follows Prime Minister Modi's meeting with Netflix Co-CEO Ted Sarandos. Industry perspectives are now integrated into academic frameworks and curriculum design.

items.title: L&T partners with French firm to market specialised road construction equipment in India
items.summary: Larsen & Toubro has joined forces with FAYAT Road Equipment to promote BOMAG machinery within India. This partnership not only expands the product offerings for road construction but also includes essential after-sales services and spare part provisions. The infusion of BOMAG's cutting-edge technology is set to align seamlessly with L&T's overarching goal of boosting infrastructure development.

items.title: JSW MG Motor launches Hector Tomahawk EV, PHEV: Check price, range, features
items.summary: JSW MG Motor India has launched the Hector Tomahawk in electric and plug-in hybrid versions. These new models are available under a Battery-as-a-Service pricing structure. The electric variant offers a substantial range and supports fast charging capabilities. The plug-in hybrid combines petrol power with significant electric-only driving range. Deliveries for the electric model will commence in September 2026, with the hybrid following in November.

items.title: Global Market: European shares edge higher as oil prices fall, Nvidia earnings in focus
items.summary: European shares edged higher as falling oil prices eased bond yields and supported equities, while investors awaited Nvidia’s quarterly results and fresh US inflation data. The STOXX 600 gained 0.1%, with basic resources leading gains, even as energy stocks lagged amid hopes of a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Gaja Alternative share price slumps over 8% after strong debut. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.summary: Gaja Alternative's share price dropped more than 8% after a strong debut at a premium of around 16%. Despite this correction, it remained over 6% above its IPO price. Analysts suggest a cautious approach to investment while noting potential growth in India's alternative investment sector.

items.title: South India region outperforms the north across all auto segments in 1QFY27: Report
items.summary: South India showed stronger automotive demand across all segments in Q1FY27. Passenger vehicle volumes grew twenty-five percent year-on-year, with southern regions leading. Two-wheeler sales also expanded twenty percent, boosted by GST reductions and electrification. Commercial vehicle segments experienced fourteen to twenty-one percent volume growth. The scooter mix within two-wheelers continued its accelerated structural shift.

items.title: Bikaji Foods sells 30% stake in baked foods subsidiary to Bakemart founder
items.summary: Bikaji Foods International announced selling a thirty percent stake in its subsidiary. This significant stake was acquired by industry veteran Thayekunni Khaleel. Bikaji Bakes Private Limited is no longer a wholly owned subsidiary of Bikaji Foods. Bikaji Foods International retains the remaining seventy percent ownership of the subsidiary. The company's shares saw a notable increase following this strategic business announcement.

items.title: India’s flights may stay expensive even as fuel gets cheaper: S&P
items.summary: Asia-Pacific airlines may maintain higher airfares as passenger demand remains strong. This strategy allows carriers to recover elevated operating costs and bolster financial buffers. Jet fuel prices surged earlier but have since eased, though volatility persists. Airlines expect margins to improve from the fourth quarter with seasonal demand increases. Growing middle classes and economic growth in China and India support future passenger demand.

items.summary: The project's start date comes ahead of the festive season, a time when residential demand increases, a factor the company expects to tap into once registrations for sale open.

items.title: Four regional Fed banks backed rate hike ahead of July decision, minutes show
items.summary: Four regional Federal Reserve banks backed a 25-basis-point increase in the discount rate ahead of the July policy meeting, minutes showed. The recommendations highlight divisions within the Fed system as policymakers weigh persistent inflation against signs of economic weakness, with markets closely watching for clues on future interest-rate moves.

items.title: Indiabulls Limited signs Rs 3,700 crore development deal for Gurugram residential project
items.summary: Indiabulls Limited will manage a new residential project on Gurugram's Dwarka Expressway. This development spans over ten acres and has a Gross Development Value of Rs 3,700 crore. The project is slated for launch by mid-October 2026, targeting festive season demand. This agreement enhances Indiabulls' project pipeline and market participation in the region. The company expects this model to be replicated in other major Indian cities.

items.title: Hey AI, what should I buy? India's shoppers have a new shopping buddy
items.summary: Indian shoppers increasingly use AI tools for product discovery and purchasing decisions. Many consumers are comfortable with AI-powered recommendations and future household shopping assistance. Quick commerce adoption is high, with many willing to pay for faster deliveries. Gen Z is projected to become India's largest spending consumer group by 2030. Innovation in new product launches significantly drives growth in the FMCG sector.

items.title: Gabriel India forms JV with South Korea's HL Klemove for autonomous driving technology
items.summary: Gabriel India has formed a joint venture with South Korea's HL Klemove. This partnership aims to expand presence in autonomous driving solutions and electronics. Gabriel India will acquire a thirty percent less one share stake. The company is investing approximately nine hundred thirty-five crore rupees in this venture. This move diversifies Gabriel India's portfolio into future mobility segments.

items.title: India’s GDP growth likely slowed to a 4-quarter low of 7.4% in Q1: Mint poll
items.summary: Sectoral trends point to uneven growth during the quarter, with industrial and services continuing to provide support, but agricultural activity likely slowed down due to the delayed onset of the monsoon.

items.title: 14 midcap stocks crash up to 55% from their peaks. Are you holding any?
items.summary: While the Nifty Midcap 150 continues to trade near record levels, several individual midcap stocks have seen sharp declines from their 52-week highs. An analysis of ACE Equity data highlights 14 midcap stocks that have fallen between 30% and 55%, revealing the weakness beneath the index-level resilience.

items.title: Private credit play: Modulus Alternatives’ third fund crosses Rs 300 crore in first close
items.summary: Modulus Alternatives has secured over Rs 300 crore in the first close of its third private credit fund, India Credit Opportunities Fund III. The SEBI-registered Category II AIF has a target corpus of Rs 2,000 crore, including a greenshoe option, and will focus on performing credit opportunities across high-growth sectors.

items.title: Dmart owner eyes debt market comeback after 7-year hiatus, bankers say
items.summary: Avenue Supermarts is preparing to venture into the corporate debt market shortly. The retailer intends to secure around ten billion rupees via bonds with a maximum maturity of three years. Notably, the company last issued bonds back in October 2019. There is significant interest from mutual funds in these investment opportunities.

items.title: Nifty 50 stuck below 25,000: Is the IPO boom this year a reason behind the poor show of the Indian stock market?
items.summary: As the Nifty 50 struggles to break the 25,000 mark, experts debate whether the surge in IPOs is draining liquidity from the stock market or if macroeconomic factors are to blame. This article explores the intricate relationship between new IPOs and market dynamics.

items.title: TCS revs up M&As with Porsche deal, but fails to wow
items.summary: TCS is stepping up M&A to boost its AI muscle and global reach, with the €320 million Porsche-MHP deal, its third acquisition in a year. The buyout offers a near-term revenue boost, but weak auto demand, margin pressure and MHP’s falling revenue cloud the outlook.

items.title: Global Market: Fiscal dominance debate takes centre stage as government debt mounts
items.summary: Rising government debt and borrowing costs are bringing the issue of fiscal dominance back into focus, with concerns that central banks could eventually face pressure to support government financing. The debate could have implications for monetary policy, inflation, currencies and sovereign bond markets.

items.title: Amazon shuts down Mechanical Turk: Why Jeff Bezos once called it ‘artificial artificial intelligence’
items.summary: Amazon is shutting down Mechanical Turk, its crowdsourced work platform, on 30 September, 2026. Launched in 2005, the service connected workers with tasks such as data labelling and surveys, but faced declining investment, growing competition, and questions over data quality.

items.title: Hindustan Zinc vs Hindalco: Why Jefferies raised target prices for both, but prefers one over the other
items.summary: Jefferies has raised its target prices for Hindustan Zinc and Hindalco Industries, but prefers the former, retaining a Buy rating versus Hold on Hindalco. The brokerage expects stronger zinc and silver prices to boost Hindustan Zinc’s earnings, while softer aluminium prices and higher debt could weigh on Hindalco’s performance.

items.title: Hyundai goes big on India with 26 new models as it plots 100+ vehicle global offensive
items.summary: Hyundai is gearing up for an extensive expansion, aiming for over one hundred global vehicle launches and enhancements by 2030. In India, the automaker plans to unveil twenty-six new models along with an increase in production capacity. By diversifying its hybrid and extended-range electric vehicle lineup, Hyundai seeks to position India as its second-largest global hub, responding to a dynamic market landscape.

items.title: Korean manufacturers have stopped testing the Indian market. They are now committing to it.
items.summary: The shift from testing a market to supplying it changes what an exporter must bring-and Korean small manufacturers are arriving with certification, pricing and local partners already in place.

items.title: US debt burden raises longer-term risks as borrowing costs rise
items.summary: US government debt remains a cornerstone of global financial markets, but rising borrowing costs, persistent fiscal deficits and stronger competition for global capital are raising concerns over its long-term sustainability.

items.title: Mint Explainer: Why does Niti Aayog want to change India’s skilling system?
items.summary: Niti Aayog has proposed unifying India's education and training into an integrated, outcome-driven system to prepare students and workers for emerging jobs by 2047. The framework shifts the focus from simple certification to actual employment.

items.title: China's short-drama producers flood the market with cheap bets — and let audiences pick the winners
items.summary: The short-drama model offers an alternative to traditional entertainment, but rising distribution costs and audience-retention challenges remain.

items.title: Textile firms spin smart comeback in Q1, eye strong FY27
items.summary: India’s textile sector started FY27 strongly, with Q1 Ebitda rising 34% and revenue 18% year-on-year. Improving global demand, export opportunities, FTAs and government incentives are supporting growth, while Arvind, Welspun and Vardhman emerge as key outperformers.

items.summary: Madhur Knit Crafts IPO runs from 24 to 27 August, with shares priced at ₹95-100. Allotment is on 28 August, and listing on NSE SME is slated for 1 September. Subscription rates show strong retail interest at 81% after three days.

items.title: India ticks all the boxes for long-term investors: CPPIB
items.summary: CPP Investments sees data centres, infrastructure and real estate as key opportunities in India as the country’s economic growth, expanding middle class and digital economy drive demand for new assets.

items.title: Post-pandemic trend: Strong divergence in corporate profit vs investment math captures policy attention
items.summary: Post-Covid, corporate profits have beaten the pace of investment recovery in a major way. Companies are reaping greater returns from their current assets, while new investments are challenged by global uncertainties and rapid technological changes.

items.title: Purple Style Labs IPO: Price band set at ₹546-575/share, issue to open Aug 31
items.summary: IPO comprises fresh issue of equity shares aggregating up to ₹680 crore with no OFS component

items.title: The business shift in India's ₹7 lakh crore market amid gold cost pressure
items.summary: Indian jewellery sales show resilience despite lower gold volumes. Consumers now buy lighter pieces and focus on value per gram. Organised jewellers are expanding by offering diamonds and newer designs. Recycled gold is becoming a significant growth driver for retailers. The market is shifting towards branded retail and experience-driven environments.

items.title: Options turnover sinks at Dalal Street's top exchange preparing for IPO
items.summary: India's stock exchange has seen options turnover plummet to its lowest in a year, a direct consequence of newly enforced trading regulations and the adoption of a closing auction system. Cash equities trading has also dipped, marking its lowest since November. This downturn poses a significant challenge for the upcoming initial public offering by the NSE, as traders recalibrate their strategies to align with the modified auction process.

items.title: 'Too much too quickly': Indonesia's growth ambitions questioned by economists
items.summary: Indonesia has set an ambitious growth target, but economists aren't sure it can get there while keeping the deficit in check.

items.title: Iran and Oman prepare Hormuz deal as U.S. holds back on secondary sanctions
items.summary: Iran and Oman are approaching a deal to secure safe transit through the Strait of Hormuz and future administration of the vital economic artery.
